1.text: Singling out the sincerity of servitude to Allah, the Exalted.

2.text: Commanding the establishment of succession (Khilafah) on earth by upholding Islam and submitting to Allah, and warning against the condition of the Children of Israel.

3.text: Confirming that Islam is the religion of truth to refute the doubts of the People of the Book and to reinforce the believers.

4.text: Organizing the Muslim society, building relationships, preserving rights, calling to Jihad, and refuting the claim of the crucifixion of Prophet Isa.

5.text: Commanding the fulfillment of covenants and warning against imitating the People of the Book in breaking covenants.

6.text: Affirming the principle of Tawhid (Monotheism) and responding to the misguidance of the polytheists.

7.text: The truth will prevail in the confrontation against evil, and explaining the ultimate end of the arrogant in this world and the Hereafter.

8.text: The favor upon the believers through Allah's support for them in the Battle of Badr and explaining the causes of victory and defeat.

9.text: The believers have no obligations towards the polytheists and the hypocrites and their struggle, and the door of repentance is always open for those who repent and turn back.

10.text: Acknowledging prophethood with evidence, and calling the deniers to faith while warning them of the punishment.

11.text: Establishing firmness for the Prophet and the believers through the stories of previous nations, and warning of severe punishment for those who fabricate lies.

12.text: Reflecting on the gentleness of Allah's decree for His close servants (Awliya), granting them empowerment, and their good end.

13.text: Refuting those who deny revelation and prophethood by explaining the evident greatness of Allah.

14.text: Confirming the mission of explaining and conveying by the Messengers, and warning the opposers with punishment.

15.text: Warning those who mock the Quran and promising to preserve it, as a support for the Prophet and to keep him steadfast.

16.text: Mentioning various blessings as an indication of the Bestower of those blessings.

17.text: Allah establishes His Messenger and supports him with clear verses, and gives him glad tidings of victory and stability.

18.text: Explaining the methodology of dealing with various trials (Fitnah).

19.text: Refuting the beliefs of the disbelievers and Christians who believe Allah has a son, and explaining His encompassing mercy.

20.text: Happiness is attained by following the guidance of the Quran and conveying its purpose, and misery occurs due to disobeying it.

21.text: Confirming the message of prophethood, and explaining the unity of the purpose of the Prophets and Allah's care and protection for them.

22.text: Magnifying Allah, Exalted is He, and His signs, and submitting to His commands.

23.text: Explaining the success of the believers and the loss of the disbelievers.

24.text: Calling to purity and the protection of honor.

25.text: Victory belongs to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and the Quran, and protection from the doubts of the polytheists.

26.text: Explaining the signs of Allah in supporting the Messengers and destroying the deniers.

27.text: Granting the great miracle to the Prophet (peace be upon him), which is the Quran, and motivating him to be grateful and patient in conveying it to humanity.

28.text: It is the way of Allah to help the weak believers and destroy the arrogant wicked.

29.text: Commanding patience and steadfastness when tested, and explaining its good reward.

30.text: Confirming the oneness of Allah in managing affairs, and clarifying His laws in His creation.

31.text: Commanding adherence to the wisdom contained in the Quran, and warning against turning away from it.

32.text: Explaining the reality of creation and the different states of humans in this world and the Hereafter.

33.text: Explaining Allah's care for the Prophet (peace be upon him) and the protection of him and his family.

34.text: Explaining the condition of humans who are fully endowed with blessings, and Allah's laws in altering them.

35.text: Explaining the weakness of the servants who depend on the Originator of the heavens and the earth, and His absolute self-sufficiency over them.

36.text: A Surah that emphasizes the message of prophethood and the Day of Resurrection, and the proofs for both.

37.text: Allah is free from everything the polytheists falsely attribute to Him, and refuting their claims regarding angels and Jinn.

38.text: Focusing on the issue of debating falsehood and its consequences.

39.text: Calling to Tawhid (Monotheism) and sincerity to Allah, and rejecting polytheism.

40.text: Explaining the condition of those who dispute about the signs of Allah and refuting them.

41.text: Explaining the condition of the deniers of Allah, and mentioning their punishment.

42.text: Explaining the perfection of Allah's legislation and the necessity of following it, and warning against disobeying it.

43.text: Warning against being deceived by the enjoyment of the worldly life, so that it does not become a path leading to polytheism.

44.text: Threatening the disbelievers by explaining the punishment awaiting them in this world and the Hereafter.

45.text: Explaining the various conditions of all creations, from the verses related to legislation and the verses related to creation, and explaining that the excuses of the arrogant deniers of resurrection are invalid, along with threatening them.

46.text: Explaining that humans are in need of the Messenger, and warning those who turn away.

47.text: Encouraging the believers to struggle in the path of Allah, strengthening them, and demoralizing the disbelievers.

48.text: Giving glad tidings to the Prophet and the believers regarding the conquest of Makkah and its establishment.

49.text: Guarding the tongue and explaining its influence on individual faith and societal ethics.

50.text: Reminding hearts to remember death and the resurrection.

51.text: Informing Jinn and mankind that the source of their provision is from Allah alone, so that they may be sincere in their worship of Him.

52.text: The proofs used to refute the doubts of the disbelievers regarding the Prophet (peace be upon him).

53.text: Confirming the truthfulness of the revelation, that it is from Allah.

54.text: Reminding of the blessing of the easiness of the Quran, including the various verses and the oaths contained therein.

55.text: Reminding humans and Jinn about the blessings of Allah, both visible and invisible, and the traces of His mercy in this world and the Hereafter.

56.text: Explaining the condition of the servants on the Day of Return to Allah.

57.text: Elevating the soul towards faith and spending in the path of Allah.

58.text: Demonstrating the encompassing knowledge of Allah and His excellent mastery as His watchful care, and warning those who disobey Him.

59.text: Demonstrating the power of Allah and His authority in subduing the Jews and hypocrites and exposing their division, and in contrast, demonstrating the unity of the believers.

60.text: Warning the believers against allying with the disbelievers.

61.text: Encouraging the believers to support one another in the religion.

62.text: Bestowing mercy and honoring this nation with the Messenger, and explaining the virtue of Friday.

63.text: Explaining the true nature of the hypocrites and warning against them.

64.text: Warning against the failure and regret that will occur on the Day of Resurrection.

65.text: Explaining the principles of divorce and emphasizing its boundaries, and explaining the fruits of fearing Allah (Taqwa).

66.text: Calling to build a family upon the boundaries of Allah, and His pleasure must always come first.

67.text: Demonstrating the perfect sovereignty and wise capability of Allah, in order to instill fear of Him and caution against His punishment.

68.text: Allah testifies for the Prophet that he is of great moral character, and protects him and makes him steadfast.

69.text: Confirming that the Day of Resurrection and the recompense will definitely occur, without any doubt.

70.text: Explaining the condition and the recompense of the creation on the Day of Resurrection.

71.text: Explaining the methodology of calling to Allah for the caller, through the biography of Prophet Nuh (peace be upon him).

72.text: Nullifying the religion of the polytheists by explaining the condition of the Jinn and their faith after listening to the Quran.

73.text: Explaining the means that encourage fulfilling the duty of calling (Da'wah).

74.text: Commanding to actively call the disbelievers and warn them with the Hereafter and the Quran.

75.text: Expressing the capability of Allah to resurrect all creations and gather them on the Day of Resurrection.

76.text: Reminding man of the beginning of his arrival as well as the end of his life, and explaining the Paradise that Allah has prepared for him.

77.text: Warning the disbelievers that they will face destruction on the Day of Resurrection.

78.text: Explaining the evidence that indicates the capability of resurrecting, and warning to fear the ensuing punishment.

79.text: Reminding one another to remember Allah and the Hereafter.

80.text: Warning the disbelievers who do not want their Lord, with evidence regarding the resurrection.

81.text: Speaking of the perfection of the Quran in reminding the soul of the cosmic upheaval on the Day of Resurrection.

82.text: Warning man not to be heedless or neglectful of the Day of Resurrection.

83.text: Warning the unjust disbelievers of the Day of Resurrection, and giving glad tidings of that Day to the believers.

84.text: Warning man of the return to their Lord and explaining their weakness and fluctuating states.

85.text: Explaining the absolute power and encompassing knowledge of Him, His support for those He loves, and His punishment of His enemies.

86.text: Explaining the absolute power and encompassing knowledge of Him in creating man and returning man to Him.

87.text: Reminding the heart with the life of the Hereafter and eliminating attachment to the life of this world.

88.text: Reminding of the Hereafter including the reward and punishment present on that Day, and looking at the evidence that indicates the power of Allah.

89.text: Explaining the recompense of the wicked, the wisdom of tests, and the remembrance of the Hereafter.

90.text: Explaining the failure of man and the path to salvation.

91.text: Emphasizing with the longest oath in the Quran the importance of purifying the soul through obedience to Allah, and its loss through disobeying Him.

92.text: Explaining the condition of man regarding faith and charity, and the condition of each group.

93.text: Explaining the care of Allah for His Prophet both at the beginning of the command and at the end.

94.text: Bestowing complete favor upon the Prophet (peace be upon him).

95.text: Allah bestows favor upon man by making him steadfast upon the natural disposition he was created with, and the perfection of the final message.

96.text: Man is between receiving guidance through revelation and being misguided through arrogance and ignorance.

97.text: Explaining the virtue of the Night of Decree (Laylat al-Qadr).

98.text: Explaining the perfection and clarity of the message of Prophet Muhammad.

99.text: Warning of the terrors of the Day of Resurrection and the precise accounting that will occur on that Day.

100.text: Warning man against disbelief and greed, by reminding him of the Hereafter.

101.text: Stirring the hearts to remember the terrors of the Day of Resurrection and the condition of mankind while standing before their scales.

102.text: Warning those who amass wealth and are infatuated with the world, to remember the grave and the questioning.

103.text: The causes of salvation from loss.

104.text: Warning against mocking the believers out of deception due to having abundant wealth.

105.text: Explaining the power of Allah and His punishment upon those who plotted to destroy His House.

106.text: Explaining the favors of Allah upon the Quraysh and His rights over them.

107.text: Explaining the characteristics of the deniers of the religion.

108.text: Demonstrating the favor of Allah upon the Prophet (peace be upon him) with abundant good and His protection of him.

109.text: Distancing from disbelief and the disbelievers.

110.text: Giving glad tidings to the Prophet (peace be upon him) of victory and being the final Messenger.

111.text: Explaining the destruction of Abu Lahab and his wife.

112.text: Allah alone is worthy of perfection and worship; He is free from having a son, a father, or an equal.

113.text: Encouraging seeking refuge in Allah from various evils.

114.text: Encouraging seeking refuge in Allah from Satan and his whispers.
